text:
emma: Quick heads-up: noticed a subset of traffic showing up in the console as project=null while SA is present. Quota math expects project-level attribution, so this can lead to mis-billing.

ryan: I traced it to the authn-proxy fallback that uses lightweight introspection under overload. That path only returns sa_id and scopes, intentionally skipping project claim lookup to save latency.

sara: We added that fallback because OIDC calls were spiking CPU during large bursts. But we didn't update telemetry to indicate when a request went through that shortcut.

dev-bot: deploy: authn-proxy v2.4.7 -> prod (canary) at 2024-06-13T15:03:00Z

ben: Proposed fix: authn-proxy keeps a tiny in-memory SA->project hint cache (TTL 3m) populated on a background refresh. On fallback path, emit had_sa_project_hint=true and hint_project=proj-xxx. That avoids a blocking call.

maya: UX: console should not silently change numbers. Add an "attribution method" column: values HIGH (project claim), MED (sa-hint), LOW (org-only/unknown). Also show a small banner when customers opt into hints: "Attribution method changed: numbers may differ while hints are enabled."

ops: Cost/ops note: adding the hint increases event size but tiny (~12 bytes). The concern is the extra cardinality in the ingestion index if we start logging hint_project values. So the hint should be emitted as a boolean + confidence enum; only surface the actual project id in internal logs for debugging.

emma: Good call. So telemetry payload minimal: had_sa_project_hint:true, attribution_confidence:MED. Console can map MED to an inferred project when rendering, but keep storage indexable field only for confidence (to avoid cardinality explosion).

ryan: Implementation question: where do we seed the hint cache? Identity service has tenant->sa->project mapping, but it's eventually consistent. We can backfill on demand when a SA is first observed by querying identity service asynchronously.

sara: Make sure the background backfill respects rate limits. Identity team prefers a batched queue with jitter.

ben: Example record we'd emit (minimal):
```json
{
  "req_id": "req-20240613-xyz",
  "service_account": "sa-901-prod",
  "project": null,
  "had_sa_project_hint": true,
  "attribution_confidence": "MED"
}
```

ops: Add a circuit-breaker: if the identity backfill queue grows >100k pending or identity error rate >5% for 10m, flip the hint off and emit alert.

maya: For rollout UX: 1) Feature is off by default. 2) Enable internally for infra+alpha for 2 weeks. 3) Enable for top 10 customers opt-in. 4) Add explicit console toggle with clear copy + banner. 5) After monitoring, default on.

emma: Also add a migration banner on dashboards: "We started displaying inference-based project hints. Historical numbers may not match after enabling hints." Provide a link to docs explaining attribution rules.

ryan: Small implementation nuance: some SAs may migrate between projects. The hint cache should return a tuple (project_id, last_seen_ts) and we treat last_seen_ts < 5m as fresh. Otherwise mark confidence=LOW and prefer org-only attribution.

ops: Who owns runbook? I'll draft SRE steps: detection (confidence drift metric), auto-disable, and rollback. Include billing-owner contact.

ben: I'll open a PR for the authn-proxy change and add config flag auth.proxy.emit_sa_hint.

sara: I'll coordinate with identity team for a batched lookup API. Please add rate limit headers so they can surface load.

dev-bot: ticket created: INFRA-3065 "authn-proxy: SA->project hint + attribution confidence"

maya: I'll design the confidence badge and the dashboard banner mock.

emma: Owners: Emma (product + comms), Ryan (authn-proxy impl), Ben (cache + telemetry), Sara (identity coordination), Ops (SRE/runbook), Maya (console UX). Sync tomorrow 9:30am PT for PR review.

ops: Added to SRE calendar. I'll bring cost/ingest estimates.

emma: Thanks everyone — let's keep the rollouts transparent to customers. :thumbsup:
